Every day, I meet families whose loved ones gave everything to save our neighbors on 9/11. So many of our brothers and sisters were lost on that fateful day, and we continue to lose loved ones due to 9/11-related health issues.

I represent a district in which 50% of households have a cop, firefighter, or veteran living there.

We must never forget the service, sacrifice, and bravery of everyday Americans on that fateful day in the face of horrifying circumstances.

Almost 25 years on, it matters now more than ever to our communities to be home and with our friends and families tomorrow.
